shortDescription: Manage NTP servers on a BIG-IP

options.name: ntp_servers
options.description: A list of NTP servers to set on the device. At least one of C(ntp_servers) or C(timezone) is required.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the NTP servers on the system. When C(present), guarantees the NTP servers are set on the system. When C(absent), removes the specified NTP servers from the device configuration.

options.name: timezone
options.description: The timezone to set for NTP lookups. At least one of C(ntp_servers) or C(timezone) is required.
